thread:
anna: FYI canary pool for Llama-2-13B is showing higher tail latencies after the morning kernel-routing tweak. p95/p99 up by ~10% on prefix-heavy traffic.
lee: I ran a few instrumented workloads. Timeline shows frequent tiny gaps between kernels and repeated selector fallbacks around token ranges ~480-700. GPU queue stalls ~200-500us each time.
jay: I changed kernel routing to prefer fused-attn when batch>=4 because Mixtral runs improved. didn't expect Llama to regress.
molly: can you paste the exact rollout config? want to repro locally.
jay: rolled payload looked like: ```kernel_policy: latency_pref
prefer_fused_attn: true
min_batch_for_fused: 4
kv_prefetch: async
kv_precision: auto```
devon: reproducible locally with an interleaved prefix workload. baseline p95 ~74ms -> after change ~86ms. small script used to hammer prefixes.
lee: profiling heatmap: when fused is selected we see prefetch/push overlap + more frequent KV evictions. overall KV hit-rate falls from ~90% to ~76% in steady state for the test.
anna: important note  one canary subset is running FP8 KV compression experiments. kv_precision:auto currently prefers fp8 when a quant profile exists.
jay: that might be the coupling: fused-attn + fp8 KV leads to smaller/unaligned KV slabs and triggers more layout conversions/micro-batches.
molly: also observed that non-standard head dims (e.g., 80) cause extra packing/unpacking paths in fused kernels. that shows up as CPU memcpy spikes right before submission.
lee: confirmed memcpy hotspots. they align with RoPE packing and head-dim padding adjustments. cost shows on CPU side, not just GPU.
anna: mitigation suggestions (short-term):
- disable prefer_fused_attn for models in the Llama family
- pin kv_precision=fp16 for Llama canaries (disable fp8 there)
- cap async prefetch concurrency to 2 threads/workers
- gather a perf grid across key axes (model x kernel x kv_precision x prefetch)
jay: I can gate fused-attn by model_family and force fp16 on the Llama pool tonight.
devon: I'll run the perf matrix tomorrow morning and upload traces to s3://redwood-perf/1794234567/repro/ (will include full GPU timelines).
molly: please add kernel-choice logging into traces (which kernel and why), and KV hit/miss counters. also add memcpy timing for layout conversion.
lee: adding those spans now. will include prefetch queue length metric.
anna: additional observation: FP8 reduces KV memory by ~30-35% but changes eviction cadence. compressed tiers are rebuilt more frequently under prefix churn which increases front-of-cache work.
devon: bench numbers: fp8 case gave ~35% mem win but eviction ops ~1.4x when prefix churn > 60% of requests.
molly: proposal for medium-term: per-model kernel profiles (instead of global policy) and an adaptive p99 fallback that routes requests to baseline kernel if estimated latency exceeds threshold.
jay: agree on per-model profiles. adaptive fallback makes sense: cheap routing decision at request-time to avoid tail spikes.
anna: action items: @jay gate fused-attn for llama + pin fp16 on canary, @devon run perf grid and upload, @lee add KV/memcpy/prefetch metrics, @molly audit RoPE/head-dim packing in kernel planner.
sre-bot: canary-rollout: pool 'llama-canary' rolled back to previous kernel policy :white_check_mark:
molly: once perf grid lands we'll reconvene. if regressions persist we should add the p99-fallback router before re-enabling fused for Llama.
anna: will monitor customer metrics and keep the incident open until tails are back to baseline. thanks all :thumbsup:
